note: Source data for the Streetdate calendar. Edit this file, then run node scripts/build-games.mjs. confirmed = publisher page or cited public list. scheduled = public calendars agree and the day can still move. window = year only. tba = no public date.

games.name: Grand Theft Auto VI
games.blurb: Rockstar's open-world crime game is set in the state of Leonida, with a return to a modern Vice City. It launched worldwide on 19 November 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. PlayStation's store page says it does not run on PlayStation 4. A PC date has not been announced.
facts: Launch platforms are PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
Trailers introduce Lucia and Jason in Leonida.
PC remains unannounced, so this calendar leaves it TBA.
delays: The first trailer, published by Rockstar in December 2023, pointed to a 2025 window.
Rockstar later dated the game 26 May 2026.
On 6 November 2025 Rockstar moved the release to 19 November 2026, saying the extra months were for polish.

sources.name: The Verge, on the November 2025 delay

releases.note: Worldwide launch. No PC date announced.

games.name: Fable
games.blurb: Playground Games' new Fable is a fresh start in Albion, not a continuation of the Lionhead trilogy. The studio's FAQ dates the launch 23 February 2027 on Xbox Series X|S, Steam and PlayStation 5, with day-one access on Game Pass Ultimate. Premium and Collector's editions can start up to five days early, on 18 February 2027.
facts: Playground says the Forza Horizon team is separate from the Fable team.
Choices and reputation are part of the public pitch.
Early access on 18 February 2027 is for premium editions, not the standard street date.

releases.note: Standard launch. Premium editions can play from 18 February 2027.

games.name: The Witcher 4
games.blurb: CD Projekt Red's next main Witcher game does not have a release day. In November 2026 the studio's joint CEO described 2028 as the target window and asked players to wait. Public comments put Ciri in the lead role, with Geralt no longer the centre of the story. Treat 2028 as a window, not a date.
facts: No day, month or platform lock-in beyond the platforms CD Projekt has shown the game for in public listings.
A Witcher 3 expansion, Songs of the Past, has been discussed separately for 2027 and is not given a day here.

releases.note: Studio target window. Not a locked day.

games.name: The Duskbloods
games.blurb: FromSoftware's multiplayer action game is a Nintendo Switch 2 exclusive. Players become Bloodsworn and fight in online matches of up to eight people. Nintendo's store page lists 2027 and does not name a day. On 29 October 2026 the studio's Japanese site said the planned 2026 release had moved to 2027.
facts: Online play needs a Nintendo Switch Online membership, according to Nintendo's store page.
The day inside 2027 is still TBA.
delays: On 29 October 2026 FromSoftware moved the release to 2027, without naming a day.

releases.note: Year confirmed by Nintendo. Day is TBA.

games.name: Marvel's Wolverine
games.blurb: Insomniac's Wolverine game is a PlayStation 5 action-adventure published by Sony. The public 2026 release list dates it 15 September 2026. It is a single-platform launch in that list, with no Xbox, Switch or PC date recorded here.

releases.note: PS5 launch listed for this day.

games.name: Phantom Blade Zero
games.blurb: S-GAME's action RPG Phantom Blade Zero is dated 29 October 2026 for PC and PlayStation 5 in the public 2026 release list. No Xbox or Switch version is recorded on this page. The list credits S-GAME and does not name a separate publisher.

games.name: Pragmata
games.blurb: Capcom's science-fiction action-adventure Pragmata is dated 17 April 2026. The public release list puts it on PC, Switch 2, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Marketing ahead of launch centred on a young girl and an android companion.

games.name: Forza Horizon 6
games.blurb: Playground's open-world racer launched on 19 May 2026 for PC and Xbox Series X|S, in the public 2026 release list. A PlayStation 5 version is listed by later calendars for 26 January 2027. That PS5 day is marked scheduled, because this page has not opened a Sony announcement for it.

games.name: 007 First Light
games.blurb: IO Interactive's James Bond game 007 First Light is dated 27 May 2026 for PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S in the public 2026 list. Calendars place a Switch 2 version later, on 18 March 2027. The Switch 2 day is scheduled rather than confirmed on a Nintendo page this site opened.

games.name: Pokémon Pokopia
games.blurb: Pokémon Pokopia is a Switch 2 life-sim and sandbox dated 5 March 2026. The public list credits Game Freak and Omega Force as developers, with The Pokémon Company and Nintendo as publishers depending on region. It is a new game, not a port of an older Pokémon title.

games.name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
games.blurb: Nintendo's Switch 2 remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is dated 5 November 2026, developed by Nintendo EPD. The 2026 Metacritic roundup lists it among the highest-scored games of the year. This page is about that remake, not the 1998 Nintendo 64 original.

games.name: Resident Evil Requiem
games.blurb: Resident Evil Requiem is Capcom's survival-horror release dated 27 February 2026 for PC, Switch 2, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Some coverage also calls it Resident Evil 9. The public 2026 list uses the title Resident Evil Requiem.

games.name: Crimson Desert
games.blurb: Pearl Abyss's open-world action-adventure Crimson Desert is dated 19 March 2026 for PC, Mac, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. This calendar files the PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox versions. Mac is noted but has no separate page.
facts: The public list also includes macOS alongside Windows.

games.name: Metroid Ravenous
games.blurb: Metroid Ravenous is listed for 28 January 2027 on Switch 2 by several public release calendars. This page has not opened a Nintendo direct announcement for that day, so the date stays scheduled and can still move. No other platform is listed.

releases.note: Date from public calendars, not a Nintendo page opened for this entry.

games.name: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis
games.blurb: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis is listed for 12 February 2027 on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Switch 2 and PC. Public calendars agree on that day. This page marks it scheduled, because a publisher press page was not the source opened for the date. Crystal Dynamics is the studio publicly tied to the listing.

games.name: Gears of War: E-Day
games.blurb: Gears of War: E-Day is a new third-person shooter dated 6 October 2026 for PC and Xbox Series X|S. The public list credits The Coalition and People Can Fly, published by Xbox Game Studios. No PlayStation or Switch date is recorded here.

games.name: Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet
games.blurb: Naughty Dog's announced PlayStation 5 action-adventure Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet does not have a public release date. It stays TBA on this calendar. No year is assigned, even where roundups guess at one.

games.name: Persona 4 Revival
games.blurb: Persona 4 Revival is listed for 18 February 2027 on PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, with a Switch 2 date of 20 May 2027 on the same public calendars. Both days are marked scheduled. Atlus is the series developer and Sega the usual publisher.

games.name: The Elder Scrolls VI
games.blurb: Bethesda's next main Elder Scrolls game is announced and undated. This calendar does not give it a year, and it does not use an unconfirmed subtitle. Platforms are not locked here either, so the game stays TBA until Bethesda names a day.

releases.note: Announced. No date and no platform list confirmed on this page.

games.name: Hollow Knight: Silksong
games.blurb: Team Cherry's sequel sends Hornet through a haunted kingdom. Nintendo's news post and Steam both date the release 4 September 2025. The launch trailer lists PC, Switch, Switch 2, Xbox, PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5. It is filed here as a late-2025 release people still look up.

releases.note: Also on PlayStation 4 and Xbox One.

games.name: Ghost of Yōtei
games.blurb: Sucker Punch's follow-up to Ghost of Tsushima launched on PlayStation 5 on 2 October 2025. Sony's launch announcement describes Atsu, a mercenary in 17th-century Ezo. It is a PS5 game on that announcement, with standard and higher-priced editions named the same day.

games.name: Marathon
games.blurb: Bungie's extraction shooter Marathon launched on 5 March 2026 for PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, according to the public 2026 release list. It is a new multiplayer game under the Marathon name. This page does not track later live-service changes.

games.name: Saros
games.blurb: Saros is Housemarque's PlayStation 5 action game, published by Sony and dated 30 April 2026 in the public release list. The list gives it no other platform. Housemarque's earlier PS5 work includes Returnal, which is context for the studio, not a claim that Saros plays the same way.

games.name: Kingdom Hearts IV
games.blurb: Kingdom Hearts IV is announced and still undated on this calendar. Public roundups mention PC, PlayStation 5, Switch 2 and Xbox Series X|S, but they do not share a locked year. No day is invented here. The game stays TBA until Square Enix names one.

releases.note: Platforms from public listings. No year confirmed here.

games.name: Judas
games.blurb: Judas, from Ghost Story Games, is announced without a release day. Public listings pair it with PC and Xbox Series X|S and do not give a year this page is willing to lock. It stays TBA. No story details are repeated here beyond the fact of the announcement.

games.name: Borderlands 4
games.blurb: Gearbox and 2K announced Borderlands 4 for 12 September 2025, set on the planet Kairos. The publisher's news post calls that the launch day. Public calendars list PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. A Switch 2 edition is not confirmed on the 2K post this page used, so it is left off.

games.name: Pokémon Legends: Z-A
games.blurb: Pokémon Legends: Z-A launched on 16 October 2025 for Nintendo Switch and Switch 2. The Pokémon Company's press release that day says trainers and Pokémon move in real time, with moves used on command. A May 2025 news post had already named 16 October as the date.

games.name: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II
games.blurb: Warhorse's medieval role-playing sequel Kingdom Come: Deliverance II is dated 4 February 2025 for PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S on release calendars that were still current after that day. It is the follow-up to the 2018 Bohemia RPG. A Switch 2 version is not given a day here.

games.name: Civilization VII
games.blurb: Firaxis's strategy game Civilization VII is dated 11 February 2025 for PC, PlayStation, Xbox and Switch on the 2025 calendars that still listed it after launch month. This page records PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and Switch. Older consoles were also named in those listings.

releases.note: Also listed for PlayStation 4 and Xbox One.

games.name: Monster Hunter Wilds
games.blurb: Capcom's Monster Hunter Wilds launched on 28 February 2025 for PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. A Switch 2 port is dated 4 December 2026 in the public 2026 release list. The December date is the port, not a delay of the original game.

games.name: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33
games.blurb: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 is Sandfall Interactive's turn-based RPG, published by Kepler Interactive and dated 24 April 2025 for PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. It stayed on 2025 calendars after that month, which is the basis for the date here.

games.name: Doom: The Dark Ages
games.blurb: id Software's medieval-set Doom prequel, Doom: The Dark Ages, is dated 15 May 2025 for PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Bethesda Softworks is the publisher. A later story expansion, Revelations, shipped in July 2026 and is not the main date on this page.

games.name: Mario Kart World
games.blurb: Mario Kart World is Nintendo's Switch 2 racing game, dated 5 June 2025 on 2025 release calendars that still showed the date after it had passed. It is filed as a Switch 2 game only. No backwards-compatible Switch release is listed here.

games.name: Death Stranding 2: On the Beach
games.blurb: Kojima Productions' sequel launched on PlayStation 5 on 26 June 2025, the date carried on 2025 calendars after that month. The Windows version is a later port, dated 19 March 2026 in the public 2026 release list. Sony Interactive Entertainment is the publisher on that list.

games.name: Donkey Kong Bananza
games.blurb: Donkey Kong Bananza is Nintendo's 3D Donkey Kong adventure for Switch 2, dated 17 July 2025. It did not slide into the 2026 release list, which is why the July 2025 day is kept. No other platform is recorded here.

games.name: Hytale
games.blurb: Hytale, the sandbox from Hypixel Studios, entered early access on 13 January 2026 for Windows, Mac and Linux. This page files the PC early-access date. A full 1.0 day is not listed, so the game stays marked as early access rather than a finished launch.

releases.note: Early access on Windows, Mac and Linux.

games.name: Animal Crossing: New Horizons Switch 2 Edition
games.blurb: The Switch 2 edition of Animal Crossing: New Horizons is a Nintendo EPD remaster dated 15 January 2026. It is an edition of the 2020 game, not a new numbered Animal Crossing. The public list gives it to Switch 2 only.

games.name: Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade
games.blurb: Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade reached Switch 2 and Xbox Series X|S on 22 January 2026 as a port. Square Enix is both developer and publisher on the public list. The original Intergrade release on other platforms is older and is not the date used here.

games.name: Dragon Quest VII Reimagined
games.blurb: Dragon Quest VII Reimagined is Square Enix's remake, dated 5 February 2026 for PC, Switch, Switch 2, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. It is a new version of the older role-playing game, not a brand-new numbered entry.

games.name: Yakuza Kiwami 3 and Dark Ties
games.blurb: Yakuza Kiwami 3 and Dark Ties is Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio's remake package, published by Sega on 12 February 2026. The public list includes PC, Switch 2, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Dark Ties is the new story paired with the remake.

releases.note: Also on PlayStation 4. Includes the new Dark Ties story.

games.name: Mario Tennis Fever
games.blurb: Mario Tennis Fever is a new Nintendo sports game for Switch 2, dated 12 February 2026. The public list credits Nintendo and does not add another platform. It is a tennis game, separate from Mario Kart World.

games.name: Reanimal
games.blurb: Reanimal is Tarsier Studios' horror adventure, published by THQ Nordic on 13 February 2026. Platforms in the public list are PC, Switch 2, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Tarsier is the studio behind Little Nightmares, which is studio context rather than a plot summary.

games.name: High on Life 2
games.blurb: High on Life 2 is Squanch Games' comedy shooter sequel, dated 13 February 2026 for PC, Switch 2, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. The public list does not name a separate publisher. It is a follow-up to the 2022 game.

games.name: Avowed
games.blurb: Obsidian's fantasy RPG Avowed first launched on 18 February 2025 for PC and Xbox Series X|S. The PlayStation 5 version is a later port, dated 17 February 2026 in the public 2026 list. Xbox Game Studios publishes it.

games.name: Fatal Frame II: Crimson Butterfly Remake
games.blurb: Team Ninja's remake of Fatal Frame II: Crimson Butterfly is dated 12 March 2026 for PC, Switch 2, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Koei Tecmo publishes it. It is a remake of the 2003 horror game, also known as Project Zero in some regions.

games.name: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection
games.blurb: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection is Capcom's role-playing follow-up in the Stories series, dated 13 March 2026. Platforms in the public list are PC, Switch 2, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. It is a turn-based RPG spinoff, not the mainline Wilds game.

games.name: Slay the Spire II
games.blurb: Mega Crit's deck-building sequel Slay the Spire II entered early access on 5 March 2026 for PC, including Mac and Linux in the public list. A 1.0 date is not on this page. Console versions are not dated here.

releases.note: PC early access. Mac and Linux included in the source list.

games.name: Starfield
games.blurb: Starfield's PlayStation 5 version arrived on 7 April 2026 as a port of Bethesda's 2023 role-playing game. The public list credits Bethesda Game Studios and Bethesda Softworks. The date on this page is the PS5 release, not the original Xbox and PC launch.

games.name: Pokémon Champions
games.blurb: Pokémon Champions is a tactical game from The Pokémon Works, dated 8 April 2026 on Nintendo Switch in the public list, with Nintendo and The Pokémon Company publishing by region. A mobile version is dated 17 June 2026. Switch 2 is not a separate row in the list this page followed.

games.name: Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream
games.blurb: Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream is Nintendo's new social sim, dated 16 April 2026 for Nintendo Switch in the public release list. The list this page follows does not add Switch 2 as its own platform. It is a follow-up to the 3DS game.

releases.note: Nintendo Switch, per the 2026 release list.

games.name: Hades II
games.blurb: Supergiant's roguelike Hades II reached PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S on 14 April 2026 as a port. The PC version was already out before that console date, and this page does not restate an earlier PC day it has not rechecked. The April date is the console release.

releases.note: Console port. PC was already available.

games.name: Diablo IV: Lord of Hatred
games.blurb: Lord of Hatred is a Diablo IV expansion from Blizzard, dated 28 April 2026. The public list includes PC, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S. This page records the current-generation consoles and PC, and notes the older consoles in the row.

releases.note: Also on PlayStation 4 and Xbox One.

games.name: Invincible VS
games.blurb: Invincible VS is a fighting game from Quarter Up, published by Skybound Games on 30 April 2026. Platforms in the public list are PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. It is based on the Invincible series and is a versus fighter rather than an action-adventure adaptation.

games.name: Subnautica 2
games.blurb: Subnautica 2 entered early access on 14 May 2026 for PC and Xbox Series X|S. The public list credits Unknown Worlds, with Krafton also named as a publisher. A full 1.0 date is not on this page, so the entry stays early access.

releases.note: Early access. Full release not dated here.

games.name: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle
games.blurb: MachineGames' Indiana Jones adventure reached Switch 2 on 12 May 2026 as a port, published by Bethesda Softworks. The public 2026 list marks that day as a port, so earlier PC, Xbox and PlayStation releases are not restated with dates this page has not rechecked.

games.name: Mina the Hollower
games.blurb: Mina the Hollower is Yacht Club Games' action-adventure, dated 29 May 2026. The year's Metacritic roundup lists PC, Switch, Switch 2, PlayStation 4 and 5, and Xbox One and Series X|S, with a score of 90. This page records the current platforms and notes the older consoles.

releases.note: Also on PlayStation 4 and Xbox One.

games.name: Final Fantasy VII Rebirth
games.blurb: Final Fantasy VII Rebirth reached Switch 2 and Xbox Series X|S on 3 June 2026 as a port. Square Enix developed and published it. The date here is that port, not the earlier PlayStation 5 release of the same game.

games.name: Star Fox
games.blurb: A Switch 2 remake of Star Fox, developed by Velan Studios and published by Nintendo, is dated 25 June 2026. The public list calls it a rail shooter remake and gives it no other platform. It is not the 1993 original and not Star Fox Adventures, which has its own later port.

games.name: Splatoon Raiders
games.blurb: Splatoon Raiders is a new third-person game from Nintendo EPD for Switch 2, dated 23 July 2026. Nintendo publishes it. The public list does not add another platform. It sits beside the older Splatoon games rather than replacing their dates.

games.name: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced
games.blurb: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced is Ubisoft Singapore's remake of the pirate adventure, dated 9 July 2026 for PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Ubisoft publishes it. It is a remake, so the 2013 original is a different release.

games.name: Halo: Campaign Evolved
games.blurb: Halo: Campaign Evolved is a Halo Studios remake dated 28 July 2026 for PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Xbox Game Studios publishes it. The public list calls it a remake and a first-person shooter, and this page does not treat it as a new numbered Halo campaign beyond that credit.

releases.note: Remake on PC, PS5 and Xbox.

games.name: Palworld
games.blurb: Pocketpair's creature-collecting survival game Palworld left early access with a full release on 10 July 2026. The public list includes PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S. The July date is the 1.0 launch, not the original early-access day.

releases.note: Version 1.0. Also listed for Xbox One.

games.name: Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls
games.blurb: Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls is Arc System Works' Marvel fighting game, published by Sony and dated 6 August 2026 for PC and PlayStation 5. The public list does not add Xbox or Switch. The title is sometimes shortened to Marvel Tokon.

games.name: Big Walk
games.blurb: Big Walk is the new game from House House, the studio behind Untitled Goose Game, published by Panic on 4 August 2026. The Metacritic roundup for 2026 lists PC, Mac, Switch 2 and PlayStation 5, with a score of 91. This page records PC, Switch 2 and PlayStation 5 and notes Mac.

games.name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
games.blurb: Onimusha: Way of the Sword is Capcom's new Onimusha action-adventure, dated 4 September 2026 for PC, Switch 2, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. It is a new entry rather than a port of the PlayStation 2 games. Capcom is credited as the developer.

games.name: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave
games.blurb: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave is a tactical RPG from Intelligent Systems, published by Nintendo for Switch 2 on 17 September 2026. The public list gives it no other platform. It is a new Fire Emblem, not a port of an older numbered game.

games.name: EA Sports FC 27
games.blurb: EA Sports FC 27 is the annual football game dated 25 September 2026. The public list names EA Vancouver and EA Romania, published by Electronic Arts, on PC, Switch, Switch 2, PlayStation 4 and 5, and Xbox One and Series X|S. This page records the current consoles plus Switch and PC.

releases.note: Also on PlayStation 4 and Xbox One.

games.name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered
games.blurb: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered launched on 29 September 2026 for PC, Switch 2, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. CD Projekt Red and Yigsoft are credited, with CD Projekt publishing. It is a remaster of the 2015 game, not The Witcher 4, which still has no day.

games.name: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4
games.blurb: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is Infinity Ward's annual shooter, published by Activision on 23 October 2026. The public list includes PC, Switch 2, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. It is a new entry, not a port of an older Modern Warfare.

games.name: Football Manager 27
games.blurb: Football Manager 27 is Sports Interactive's management game, dated 10 November 2026. The public list includes Windows, Mac, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, iOS and Android, with Sega publishing and Netflix named for mobile. This page records PC, the two consoles and mobile, and notes Mac.

releases.note: Also on Mac. Netflix is named for the mobile editions.

games.name: Warhammer Survivors
games.blurb: Warhammer Survivors is Auroch Digital's bullet-heaven action game, dated 10 November 2026. The public list includes PC, Switch, Switch 2, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. It is a separate release from Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV later in the year.

games.name: Pikmin 4 Switch 2 Edition
games.blurb: The Switch 2 edition of Pikmin 4, with the Dandori Academy expansion, is dated 12 November 2026. Nintendo EPD and Eighting are credited, and Nintendo publishes it. It is an edition of the existing Pikmin 4, not a new numbered Pikmin.

games.name: Am I Nima
games.blurb: Am I Nima is a PC horror game listed for 27 November 2026. Store listings describe it as psychological horror with hand-drawn art and choices. A studio credit and a publisher press release were not opened for this entry, so the day stays scheduled.

releases.note: PC listing. Studio credit not locked here.

games.name: Arkheron
games.blurb: Arkheron is listed as an early-access launch on 27 November 2026 for PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Public calendars agree on the day and on the early-access label. A 1.0 date and a studio credit are not locked on this page.

releases.note: Early access. Studio credit not locked here.

games.name: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World
games.blurb: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World is a new monsters RPG dated 3 December 2026. Tose developed it and Square Enix publishes it. Platforms in the public list are PC, Switch, Switch 2, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

games.name: Rayman Legends Retold
games.blurb: Rayman Legends Retold is Ubisoft's remake of the platformer, dated 3 December 2026 for PC, Switch 2, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Ubisoft Montpellier and Ubisoft Milan are credited. It is a retelling of Rayman Legends, not a new Rayman numbered sequel.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV
games.blurb: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV is a real-time strategy game from King Art Games, published by Deep Silver on 3 December 2026 for PC. The public list does not add consoles. It is the next numbered Dawn of War, separate from other Warhammer games dated nearby.

releases.note: PC only in the public list.

games.name: Xenoblade Chronicles 3 Switch 2 Edition
games.blurb: The Switch 2 edition of Xenoblade Chronicles 3 is a Monolith Soft remaster published by Nintendo on 3 December 2026. The public list files it as a Switch 2 release. It is an edition of the existing game, not a new numbered Xenoblade.

games.name: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered
games.blurb: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered is Nightdive's stealth remaster, with Eidos-Montréal also credited, published by Atari on 3 December 2026. Platforms include PC, Switch, Switch 2, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, plus older consoles in the source list. It is a remaster of the 1998 game.

releases.note: Also on PlayStation 4. Eidos-Montréal is also credited.

games.name: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam
games.blurb: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam is Level-5's puzzle adventure, dated 10 December 2026. The public list includes PC, Switch, Switch 2 and PlayStation 5, and credits Level-5's Osaka office. It is a new Layton mystery, not a port of an older case.

games.name: Attack on Titan 3
games.blurb: Attack on Titan 3 is Omega Force's hack-and-slash game, published by Koei Tecmo on 10 December 2026. Platforms in the public list are PC, Switch 2, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. It is a new game in the series, not a rerelease of the earlier Koei Tecmo titles.

games.name: Path of Exile 2
games.blurb: Path of Exile 2's full release is dated 11 December 2026 for PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Grinding Gear Games develops and publishes it. The public list marks this as the 1.0 launch, so earlier early-access time is not the date used here.

games.name: Witchbrook
games.blurb: Witchbrook, Chucklefish's magic-school life sim, is listed for 28 January 2027 on PC, Switch, Switch 2, Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5. The day comes from public calendars and is marked scheduled. It has been announced for a long time, and this page does not treat older windows as a formal delay list.

games.name: Exodus
games.blurb: Exodus is Archetype Entertainment's science-fiction RPG, listed for 7 April 2027 on PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Wizards of the Coast is the studio's publisher. The day is marked scheduled because it comes from public calendars rather than a press page opened for this entry.

games.name: Outward 2
games.blurb: Outward 2 is listed as a PC early-access launch on 8 February 2027. Nine Dots Studio made the first Outward, and that credit is used here for the sequel. The day is scheduled, and a 1.0 date is not on this page.

games.name: Danganronpa 2x2
games.blurb: Danganronpa 2x2 is listed for 14 January 2027 on PC, PlayStation 5, Switch and Switch 2. Spike Chunsoft is the series developer, and that credit is used here. The day is scheduled from public calendars and can still move.

games.name: Metro 2039
games.blurb: Metro 2039 is listed for 4 February 2027 on PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. 4A Games and Deep Silver are the series' usual studio and publisher, and those credits are used with that caveat. The day is scheduled, not confirmed from a press page opened for this entry.

releases.note: Calendar date. Studio credit follows the series.

games.name: Until Dawn 2
games.blurb: Until Dawn 2 is listed as a PlayStation 5 horror game for 28 January 2027. Public calendars agree on the day. A studio credit is not locked on this page, so none is shown. The date stays scheduled and can still move.

releases.note: Calendar date. Studio not locked here.

games.name: Clockwork Revolution
games.blurb: Clockwork Revolution is inXile's announced role-playing game for PC and Xbox. Public calendars put it in 2027 without a day, so this page uses a 2027 window and leaves the day TBA. It is not given a made-up month.

games.name: Bloodstained: The Scarlet Engagement
games.blurb: Bloodstained: The Scarlet Engagement is the announced prequel to Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night. Public calendars place it in 2027 on PC and PlayStation 5 without a day. The day stays TBA. A studio credit is not locked on this page.
